verdict.rationale: Checkout.com exposes a comprehensive, well-documented public REST API (idempotency, OAuth 2.0/API-key auth, rate limits, webhooks, SDKs) plus explicit AI-native access paths: an official MCP server (confirmed live and auth-gated by an independent probe) for driving payment operations from an AI IDE, and documented agentic-commerce integrations (ChatGPT, Google AI) enabling agents to programmatically create orders/payments. Missing for 10: no publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probed and 404) and no independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and the MCP probe.
